TGO.note: Document states no rule or authority on AI harms.
Administration use is stated only as a possible future use of the models; no government body is using or testing an AI system.
Sector services are stated only as future possibilities; results of the challenge are still to come.

facts.fact: UNDP Togo says the Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation launched, through the Togo AI Lab, a national local languages challenge whose pilot phase aims to develop AI models for Kabye, Ewe and Moba.
facts.system: Challenge national des langues locales (Voix du Togo)

facts.fact: UNDP says it is supporting the Togo AI Lab in setting up a GPU-based AI infrastructure, presented as a supercomputer, to train local-language models; no specification, cost or commissioning date is given.

systems.owner: Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation / Togo AI Lab

TGO.note: Startups are named only as future users of the resources; no startup law, label or fund stated.
Togo AI Lab is not stated to host startups or run an incubation programme.
